sources.title: CMS Collaboration, CMS-PAS-SMP-25-002, “Constraints on Effective Field Theory operators from multiboson production measurements at 13 TeV”
sources.locator: Full PAS report; inaccessible during the five recorded retrieval attempts. The accessible official result page supplies only the abstract and summary-level channel/operator/method/result claims.

items.argument: Author only the official page’s explicit conditional record: 2016–2018 CMS pp data at 13 TeV with 138 fb^-1; ten listed channels; six CP-even bosonic Warsaw dimension-six coefficients; event-by-event LO-MC reweighting to detector level; binned profile-likelihood scenarios; and the page’s qualitative no-significant-deviation statement. Do not infer numeric limits, event selections, calibration details, nuisance correlations, or coverage from inaccessible figures/snippets. No alternative proof can supply missing empirical observations.
items.unresolved: Full PAS text, exact event selections and calibration, nuisance/correlation model, detailed test calibration, and observed/expected intervals remain unavailable. Read and compare the actual PAS interface before clearing this source escalation.
